name: prfcompletion-fp-cpl0

Environment CW/SW/TAG store readbacks cover architected low16 fields only, not every byte/reserved field in the28-byte image.

IRETD entered RF1, automatic fault RF0->1 setting and CPU-generation oracle discrepancies remain outside scope.
Prepared standalone four-case driver only; not registered with the generic single-image run-sys-golden flow.
